title: Vitta
text: Kiṃsūdha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ || kiṃsu suciṇṇo sukham āvahāti || kiṃsu have sādutaraṃ rasānaṃ || kathaṃ jīviṃ jūvitam āhu seṭṭhan ti || || Saddhīdha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭham || dhammo suciṇṇo sukham āvahāti || saccam have sādutaram rasānam || paññājīviṃ jīvitaṃ āhu setthaṇ ti || ||
